2.text: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

3.text: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].<sup foot_note="227954">1</sup>

footnotes.227954: - According to their deeds rather than wealth and social position, as is the case in this world.

4.text: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

5.text: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

8.text: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?<sup foot_note="227955">1</sup>

footnotes.227955: - i.e., those given their records in their right hand and who are destined for Paradise.

9.text: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?<sup foot_note="227956">1</sup>

footnotes.227956: - i.e., those given their records in their left hand and who are destined for Hell.

10.text: And the forerunners, the forerunners<sup foot_note="227957">1</sup> -

footnotes.227957: - The words can also be understood as a complete sentence, i.e., "The forerunners [in good deeds] are the forerunners [in entering Paradise]."

11.text: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

13.text: A [large] company of the former peoples

14.text: And a few of the later peoples,

16.text: Reclining on them, facing each other.

17.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

18.text: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

19.text: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

20.text: And fruit of what they select

21.text: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

22.text: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

24.text: As reward for what they used to do.

25.text: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

27.text: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

28.text: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

35.text: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation

37.text: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

38.text: For the companions of the right [who are]

39.text: A company of the former peoples

40.text: And a company of the later peoples.

41.text: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

42.text: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

43.text: And a shade of black smoke,

45.text: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

46.text: And they used to persist in the great violation,<sup foot_note="227958">1</sup>

footnotes.227958: - i.e., shirk (association with Allāh) or disbelief.

47.text: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

49.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples

50.text: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

51.text: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

52.text: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

53.text: And filling with it your bellies

54.text: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

55.text: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

56.text: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

57.text: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

58.text: Have you seen that which you emit?<sup foot_note="227959">1</sup>

footnotes.227959: - i.e., semen, which contains the potential for human life.

59.text: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

60.text: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

61.text: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.<sup foot_note="227960">1</sup>

footnotes.227960: - An alternative meaning has also been given:  "...in that We will replace the likes of you [with others upon the earth] and create you [in the Hereafter] in that which you do not know."

62.text: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

63.text: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

64.text: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

65.text: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,<sup foot_note="227961">1</sup>

footnotes.227961: - At what had happened or remain in a state of shock.  Another meaning is "in regret."

68.text: And have you seen the water that you drink?

69.text: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

70.text: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

71.text: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

72.text: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

73.text: We have made it a reminder<sup foot_note="227962">1</sup> and provision for the travelers,<sup foot_note="227963">2</sup>

footnotes.227962: Of the great fire of Hell.
footnotes.227963: In the form of flints or other means by which to ignite fire.  Travelers are mentioned because of the special convenience to them, although it is a provision for all people in general.

74.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

75.text: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,<sup foot_note="227964">1</sup>

footnotes.227964: - Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) confirms absolutely by oath.

76.text: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

77.text: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.

footnotes.227965: - The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

79.text: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].

80.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

81.text: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

82.text: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

83.text: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat

84.text: And you are at that time looking on -

85.text: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

86.text: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

87.text: Bring it back,<sup foot_note="227966">1</sup> if you should be truthful?

footnotes.227966: - i.e., return the soul to the body, meaning that just as you cannot prevent death when it is decreed, you will not escape the recompense when it is decreed.

88.text: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],

89.text: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

90.text: And if he was of the companions of the right,

91.text: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

92.text: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

93.text: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

95.text: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

96.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
